newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Ireland to be included in Salomon world bond index.
newsitem.headline: Ireland to be included in Salomon world bond index.

text.p: Ireland will be included in Salomon Brothers World Government Bond Index (WGBI) as of March 31, 1997, Salomon Brothers said.
Ireland satisfied the entry criteria for the WGBI for the third consecutive month as of December 31, 1996.

To be eligible for entry into the WGBI, a market's capitalisation based on eligible issues must total at least $20 billion, 30 billion marks and 2.5 trillion yen for three consecutive months, Salomon said.
